title: POSR Documentation
intro: Role-based guides for POSR. Choose a guide that matches your job: floor staff, manager, inventory, accounts, HR, or administrator.

employee.title: Employee Guide
employee.intro: Day-to-day POS work for floor staff: sign-in, take orders, cart and payment, manage open checks, lock the terminal, and clock out.

manager.title: Manager Guide
manager.intro: Shift leadership: sales summary, kitchen board, delivery, closing, and operational reports.

inventory.title: Inventory Guide
inventory.intro: Stock, purchases, issues, wastes, counts, kitchen reconciliation, production, and buffet.

accounts.title: Accounts Guide
accounts.intro: Financial ledgers, expenses, and accounting-related POS tools.

hr.title: HR Guide
hr.intro: People operations: employees, attendance, leave, payroll, documents, performance, and tip distribution.

admin.title: Administrator Guide
admin.intro: Venue configuration: Manage, integrations, and advanced settings.
